verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's own MCP server lets terminal agents such as Claude Code and Codex read and edit the Model and drive Ari chats without the web UI, which gives some programmatic, UI-less operation. But the docs say no API keys or access tokens are issued: every client must sign in as a person through browser OAuth approval. That works against unattended CI runs, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: non-interactive or service-account auth for CI, a documented REST API or CLI, CI/pipeline setup guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of headless automation.
